posts.text: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings fail to systematically penalize companies for deforestation. Incorporating quantifiable spatial deforestation data—such as data from remote sensing—into assessments could help inform ratings. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/rW0550ZPSs9

posts.text: Irrigation increases crop yields, which reduces the need for agricultural land and thus the clearing of forests and associated carbon emissions. A study estimates that US irrigation provides an estimated gross GHG benefit of 6.86 Gt CO2e annually. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/Rura50ZPSuB
